side_left.orientation: Nose at left. Trailing flame tips at right. Number reads left to right.

side_right.orientation: Nose at right. Trailing flame tips at left. Number reads left to right.

tire.mapping: Square sidewall overlay with circular LIGHTYEAR lettering at top and bottom; transparent wheel center. Center at atlas pixel [1768,1780]; outer glyph radius approximately 202 px.

sampling: Use alpha blend or alpha clip; keep the PNG alpha. Pixel rectangle origin is top-left. Blender bounds are [u_min,v_min,u_max,v_max]. Surface corners ordered bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left map directly to those bounds. Clamp to margins to avoid neighboring decals.
ownership_note: Original vector recreations of decals inspired by the user-supplied Lightning McQueen toy photo 1000055161.jpg. Lightning McQueen, Rust-eze, the 95 livery, LIGHTYEAR and fictional sponsor identities are recognizable third-party fictional-character branding, not newly invented intellectual property. No commercial licence or ownership of the fictional identity is claimed. The reference photo is not used as a texture or billboard.
simplifications: Tiny contingency sponsor marks are simplified type-and-color recreations. The 95 numerals are custom chamfered, forward-leaning race vectors; the main wordmarks are custom outlined vector typography. All SVG lettering is editable paths; no external fonts required.
